notes: A MONTH-END CHECK THAT COULD NOT BE READ NO LONGER COUNTS AS A CHECK THAT PASSED. Before you sign a month off, the month-end close asks your books two questions: is anything dated in the month still unposted, and is every bank account reconciled. If one of those questions failed — not "the answer is none", but "the answer could not be obtained" — the blank was being treated as good news: "nothing left unposted", "no bank accounts to reconcile", said over a bank account that plainly exists. Both must be green for a clean sign-off, so the checklist went green, the sign-off proceeded with no warning at all, and that green result was written into the month-end record — the record you or your accountant open months later, long after anyone would remember a hiccup. A check whose question failed now says so, cannot be ticked off, and the page tells you which one failed. The same applies to "has this month already been signed off": when that could not be answered, a closed month looked open, inviting a second sign-off on top of the first. ABOUT THE PREVIOUS RELEASE'S NOTES. Version 0.8.65 said that all thirty-three findings from its review were fixed. That was not correct, and the one you are reading about is the one that was missed — raised, confirmed twice, then left out because the closing summary counted batches of work rather than the findings themselves. It was caught by going back through the finished release screen by screen instead of re-reading the summary. Nothing else from that review was affected; the other thirty-two were re-checked and are in place. The review record now closes by listing every finding and showing none is unaccounted for. We would rather tell you this than let a release note stand that was not true. There are no data changes in this release. Back up before installing, then install over the top; your books are untouched.
